scope: PTS postcode governance, public PostNord lookup/system/change references, current Postnummerservice service/statistics/purchase terms and indexed five-digit surface product, and Lantmäteriet INSPIRE address product/specification/technical/rights documents were audited without provider contact, registration, authentication, application, terms or contract acceptance, product purchase, protected query submission, access-control bypass, publication destination or deployment.

countryIdentity.rule: Sweden retains repository SE and ledger region Europe. PostNord, PTS, Postnummerservice, Lantmäteriet, municipal, administrative and any adjacent-country or region identities remain separate; no source identity, territory or coverage was changed, merged or reassigned.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete five-digit Swedish postcode assignment and explicit delivery/endpoint exception denominator and corresponding valid Polygon/MultiPolygon coverage are usable under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Provider, product, edition, reference date, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, gaps, conflicts and exceptions are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. Any surface derived from complete address membership is labelled derived and noncanonical. The real SE API/app normalizes NNN NN to five text digits, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; poste-restante, P.O.-box, reply/freepost, competition-mail, large-customer, organization, route, point, unmatched and other non-area records remain explicit. No address Point, municipal/administrative boundary, building/parcel object, download envelope, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2, and SE/source territorial identity remains unchanged.

officialObservations.finding: PTS states that postcodes exist only to route mail, need not follow districts, municipalities or counties, and are administered by appointed PostNord; larger changes require PTS approval. This is postal governance, not a perimeter release.

The current PostNord search and indexed guidance support individual address/postcode lookup and state that small changes may occur through the year while larger annual changes for 2026 took effect 2 March 2026. Standard public GET returned Cloudflare 403 in this audit; no bypass or bulk query was attempted.

PTS links the PostNord/Postnummerrådet system fact sheet. Indexed official text distinguishes ordinary delivery codes from poste-restante, P.O.-box, reply/freepost, competition-mail and large-customer codes and states that large-customer codes do not specify exact geographic location. The exact PDF body returned Cloudflare 403 and was not fixed.

Postnummerservice advertises weekly updated quality-controlled address, postcode and geodata through partnerships with national postal operators, land survey agencies and official authorities. Its current statistics page advertises approximately 17,000 postcodes, 1,743 post towns and 10,500 deliverable postcodes; these are approximate product metrics, not an exact current denominator.

A search-indexed 2026 price PDF identifies a Swedish five-digit postcode-surface product. The exact price asset currently redirected with HTTP 301 to the general postcode page, and no product was purchased or delivered. Current purchase terms grant use within the organization and prohibit resale and sublicensing, so AGID public serving is not authorized.

Lantmäteriet advertises municipality-partitioned address data with postcode/post town, GML, EPSG:3006/4258 and half-year updates. Ordering provides a download login and use requires legal-purpose review and special terms. The reviewed INSPIRE example is an entrance Point, not a postcode surface.

Specification version 2.0 published 2024-06-05 says municipalities maintain addresses and notify PostNord; PostNord decides postcode/post town and normally returns a code within 14 days, or 30 days for newly addressed areas. The address record is address-object grain, with postcode optional, and not postal perimeter authority.

Terms version 1.1 dated 2025-03-04 applies CC BY 4.0 with attribution and processed-data disclosure, while personal data may be processed only for the purpose stated in an application and approved by Lantmäteriet, with geographic-necessity and storage conditions. No application, approval or dataset delivery occurred.

rightsAssessment.note: This is a conservative engineering gate, not legal advice. A commercial product listing, CC BY address terms and public-page visibility are not silently widened into authorization for an unfixed postal-surface delivery or AGID public serving.

dataQualityAssessment.intendedGrain: one current five-digit postcode assignment or explicit deliverability/endpoint exception reconciled to one or more valid source/derived postal areas or explicit non-area
dataQualityAssessment.postnummerservicePublishedStatisticsGrai: approximate aggregate counts, not exact assignment rows or exception denominator
dataQualityAssessment.lantmaterietAddressGrain: one municipality-maintained address object with optional PostNord postcode/post-town attributes and entrance Point
dataQualityAssessment.commercialSurfaceProductGrain: advertised five-digit area product whose exact delivery, method, edition, coverage, CRS, topology and exceptions were not inspected
dataQualityAssessment.blockingRisk: Approximate counts and address points cannot prove complete current membership, while an unpurchased organization-only surface product cannot be inspected or publicly served. Deriving or substituting areas would create false coverage and false rights.

browserReview.reason: No approved fixed rights-cleared SE postcode-area artifact exists. The commercial listing, address Points, municipal envelopes and synthetic or inferred geometry were not staged as false postal areas.

reportPresentation.reason: The exact gate table communicates the decisive rights, grain and geometry mismatch without suggesting quantitative completeness from approximate market statistics.

blockerSummary: Sweden has clear official governance, current address/postcode maintenance and an advertised commercial five-digit postcode-surface product. However, no product delivery or current complete assignment/endpoint exception denominator was acquired, the current commercial licence is organization-only with resale and sublicensing prohibited, Lantmäteriet access requires an approved purpose and supplies address Points rather than postal areas, and no fixed compatible public-serving Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact was validated. No real SE runtime, API or map area can be promoted.
